name: reveal-field
title: Reveal Field
description: A password field with an eye that blinks as the text turns between dots and letters, and a slash that wipes away.

perf.budget: A native text input and a 24 pt Skia icon driven by four shared values. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The text and the slash switch at once, without the blink.
a11y.screenReader: A secure text field named by its label, and a button named "Show password" or "Hide password".
a11y.touchTarget: The eye button is 48 by 50 pt; the field is 52 pt tall.
